sections.heading: Panipat Refinery at Baholi: North India's Refining and Petrochemical Base
paragraphs: Panipat's process industry is anchored by Indian Oil's refinery at Baholi, set up in 1998 as the seventh refinery of Indian Oil Corporation. It started at 6.0 million tonnes per annum, was raised to 12 MMTPA in 2006 and to 15 MMTPA in 2010, and Indian Oil reports an expansion to 25 MMTPA under execution. Crude reaches it through the Salaya–Mathura pipeline, which also feeds the Mathura and Vadodara refineries, and the refinery supplies petroleum products to Haryana, Punjab, Jammu and Kashmir, Himachal Pradesh, Chandigarh, Uttarakhand and parts of Rajasthan and Delhi.

Alongside fuels, the complex has grown into a petrochemical site. Its PTA plant, commissioned in mid-2006, is described by Indian Oil as the largest in the country, and the paraxylene–PTA project was set up to produce 360 thousand tonnes of paraxylene and 553 thousand tonnes of purified terephthalic acid a year. The Panipat Naphtha Cracker was commissioned in March 2010 at 857 KTA of ethylene and later revamped to 947 KTA, producing polypropylene, polyethylene, MEG, benzene and butadiene, with butadiene and butene-1 units added in 2013 and 2014.

sections.heading: Where Electropolished Tube Fits in a Panipat Refinery or Cracker
paragraphs: Most refinery and cracker piping is carbon or alloy steel, so electropolished stainless is not a bulk item at Baholi. Its place is in the small-bore systems that decide whether the plant's measurements can be trusted: analyser sample lines, sample conditioning panels, impulse lines to pressure and flow transmitters, and chemical injection and dosing lines. A rough or contaminated bore in a sample line adsorbs and releases trace components, slows the analyser's response and can give a reading that reflects the tube rather than the stream.

For these services we supply seamless ASTM A269 instrument tube in 316L, and where the stream is aggressive, 904L supplied electropolished. Electropolishing removes the cold-worked surface left by drawing, lowers the Ra, and leaves a chromium-enriched passive layer, so moisture, sulphur compounds and trace hydrocarbons are less likely to hang up on the wall between samples. For larger utility and process headers, ASTM A312 pipe in 304L or 316L covers the stainless runs a refinery does use.

sections.heading: Panipat's 2G and 3G Ethanol Plants: SF1 or SF4?
paragraphs: Panipat also hosts two of Indian Oil's newer bio-fuel units. Indian Oil records its 3G ethanol plant as commissioned in March 2023 and its 2G ethanol plant in April 2023. Second-generation ethanol is made from lignocellulosic biomass rather than molasses or grain: the biomass is pretreated and broken down with enzymes before the sugars are fermented, so a 2G plant combines hot, chemically aggressive front-end service with fermentation and distillation stages that have to be kept free of contaminating organisms.

The grade choice follows the stage. SF1 mechanically polished 304L or 316L, to ASME BPE surface designations, is a sound fit for utility water, cooling and transfer lines that are cleaned but not held to hygienic standard. Fermentation feed, enzyme dosing, yeast propagation and CIP return lines are where an SF4 electropolished 316L bore earns its cost, because residue and biofilm have fewer surface defects to anchor in and CIP cycles clear the line faster. Lines carrying acids or chlorides from pretreatment are the ones to review for 904L.

sections.heading: Documents a Panipat Refinery or Contractor Will Ask For
paragraphs: Turnaround and expansion work at a refinery runs through main contractors and inspection agencies, and stainless tube is released to site only against complete paperwork. Each heat we supply carries an EN 10204 3.1 certificate traced to its heat number, with chemical analysis from a NABL-accredited laboratory. Every length is checked by PMI, which matters on a site where 304L, 316L and 904L may sit in the same lay-down area and a mixed-up length is a serious finding.

Each electropolished lot comes with our internal Ra report, so the inspector can match the stated finish against the line list. We work under ISO 9001:2015. If your inspection test plan calls for extra witness points or a specific marking format on each length, state it in the enquiry so the quotation reflects it.

sections.heading: Sending a Panipat RFQ
paragraphs: We quote within 24 hours of a complete enquiry. For Panipat refinery, petrochemical or ethanol-plant work, it helps to include:
bullets: The unit or package the tube is for (refinery analyser shelter, PX-PTA, naphtha cracker, 2G or 3G ethanol) and whether you are the plant, an EPC contractor or a panel or skid builder.
Grade and finish per line: 316L or 904L electropolished instrument tube for sample and impulse lines, SF4 316L for fermentation and CIP, SF1 304L or 316L for utilities.
Size, wall thickness, length and quantity, with the standard: ASTM A269 or A270 tube, A249 welded tube, A312 pipe.
Your inspection test plan or third-party inspection requirements, and the delivery point at site.
